pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregularly shaped polygonal dark brown regions with moderately sharp pixel gradients and jagged edges. Geometry is more elongated on the neck and more balanced in aspect ratio on the flank.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored negative-space network with frequent trivalent junction nodes. Pixel thickness is variable, with noticeable widening at the vertices of the topological graph.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrated contour along the dorsal neck, formed by individual hair tufts projecting against the sky background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A distinct linear indentation/crease is visible on the lower ventral-lateral abdomen area.
other_distinctive_markers: Two oxpecker birds (Buphagus) are perched on the upper neck and shoulder. A unique 'C-shaped' light-pelage interruption is present within the patch pattern on the posterior flank.
